# PDF Image Studio

> Private, 100% browser-based PDF and image tools. Fast, zero-upload processing with WebAssembly and HTML5 Canvas.

## Overview
PDF Image Studio is a privacy-first web application that converts, compresses, organizes, edits, and optimizes PDF documents and image files entirely on the client side. No files are uploaded to foreign or remote servers.

## Key Features & Tools
- PDF Page Organizer (/pdf-organizer): Reorder, rotate, delete, duplicate, and extract PDF pages visually.
- Merge PDF (/merge-pdf): Combine multiple PDF documents into a single file.
- Split PDF (/split-pdf): Extract page ranges or split PDFs by bookmarks.
- Compress PDF (/compress-pdf): Reduce PDF file sizes with local canvas and image compression algorithms.
- Image Compressor (/image-compressor): Lossless and lossy photo compression with live quality preview.
- Image Converter (/image-converter): Convert between JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, and SVG.
- Image Resizer & Crop (/image-resizer, /image-crop): Crop and adjust dimensions with pixel precision.
- PDF Watermark & Page Numbers (/pdf-watermark, /pdf-page-numbers): Add stamps, watermarks, and headers/footers.
- PDF Metadata & Flatten (/pdf-metadata, /pdf-flatten): Edit document properties and flatten form fields.
- Batch Processor (/batch-processor): Execute batch transformations on multiple files concurrently.

## Technical Architecture & Privacy
- Execution: 100% Client-Side JavaScript, WebAssembly, and HTML5 Canvas.
- Privacy: Zero file uploads. No telemetry or server-side document storage.
- Offline Support: Progressive Web App (PWA) with Service Worker caching.
- Base URL: https://pdfimage.pages.dev/
